authority_sources.label: Trieste Terminal Passeggeri — cruise terminal (Stazione Marittima)
authority_sources.used_for: Central maritime station near Piazza Unità; berths 29–30; other seasons/Sistiana named only as conditional.

portInfo.description: Trieste is a distinct Adriatic cruise gateway—not a substitute for Venice or Ravenna cruise terminals. Trieste Terminal Passeggeri operates the city-centre Stazione Marittima (passenger halls 41–42) a short walk from Piazza Unità d’Italia. Confirm your berth on the daily programme; some programmes use other landings (for example overflow berths or the Sistiana area) and may need a ship shuttle or taxi.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Stazione Marittima — Molo dei Bersaglieri area (confirm berth name on your sailing programme)
transportation: Walking to Piazza Unità and the waterfront
gettingThere.distanceToCity: When your ship uses the central Stazione Marittima, Piazza Unità d’Italia is a short waterfront walk. Other berths need the ship’s transfer guidance—do not assume the same walk.
gettingThere.walkingTime: A few minutes on foot toward Piazza Unità d’Italia when berthed at the central maritime station—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Urban buses link the centre, railway station and Miramare corridor—confirm routes, tickets and timetables on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Piazza Unità d’Italia and the Rive waterfront — straightforward on foot from the central terminal when your berth is confirmed there.
Miramare Castle — treat as a half-day outing; use a ship excursion or pre-arranged taxi/bus and confirm opening hours before you commit.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: Miramare or a second stop is realistic only with confirmed transport, verified opening hours, and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm berth and gangway first; Miramare is outside the compact waterfront core—do not squeeze it into a tight call without booked transport.
